result.instructions: Tools for Survicate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which surveys in our workspace received the most responses this month?"; "Show the NPS answers from enterprise customers (plan = Enterprise) since Monday."; "List every response that mentions pricing, with the respondent's company attribute.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Survicate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run survicate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run survicate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run survicate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. survicate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: survicate_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List the surveys in the workspace, newest first, with their type and metadata. Filter by creation date with start (newer bound) and end (older bound). Data Export API: GET /surveys.

items_per_page.description: Items per page (1-100). Omit for the API default.

start.description: Newer bound of the creation date range, inclusive.

end.description: Older bound of the creation date range, inclusive. Must be earlier than start.

next_url.description: pagination_data.next_url from the previous call. Pass it to get the next page; other paging inputs are then ignored.

tools.name: survicate_get_survey
tools.title: Get a survey
tools.description: Get one survey by id: its name, status, type, and the names of respondent attributes sent with its responses (use these names in attribute lookups). Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}.

tools.name: survicate_list_questions
tools.title: List survey questions
tools.description: List the questions of one survey, with their types and possible answers. Use it to map question ids to answers before reading responses. Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/questions.

items_per_page.description: Items per page (1-100). Omit for the API default.

next_url.description: pagination_data.next_url from the previous call. Pass it to get the next page; other paging inputs are then ignored.

tools.name: survicate_list_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List the responses of one survey, newest first, with answers, device, language and collected_at. Narrow by time range, by named attributes (attributes, up to 100 names) and by attribute filters. Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/responses.

start.description: Newer bound (inclusive). Must be later than end.

items_per_page.description: Items per page (1-100). Omit for the API default.

attributes.description: Attribute names to return with each response. Names are case-sensitive. Omitted = no attributes returned.

attribute_type.description: respondent = attribute of the person; response = attribute recorded with that response.

value.description: Compared value. One string; omit for is_unknown or has_any_value.

next_url.description: pagination_data.next_url from the previous call. Pass it to get the next page; other paging inputs are then ignored.

tools.name: survicate_get_response
tools.title: Get a survey response
tools.description: Get one response by uuid: answers, device, language, collected_at, the response's own attributes, and respondent attributes you name (up to 10). Data Export API: GET /surveys/{survey_id}/responses/{response_uuid}.

respondent_attributes.description: Respondent attribute names to return under respondent.attributes (up to 10).

tools.name: survicate_list_respondent_responses
tools.title: List a respondent's responses
tools.description: List every survey response from one respondent across surveys, newest first. Response attribute arrays are empty here; read attributes with survicate_list_respondent_attributes. Data Export API: GET /respondents/{respondent_uuid}/responses.

respondent_uuid.description: The respondent uuid (from a response's respondent object).

items_per_page.description: Items per page (1-100). Omit for the API default.

next_url.description: pagination_data.next_url from the previous call. Pass it to get the next page; other paging inputs are then ignored.

tools.name: survicate_list_respondent_attributes
tools.title: List a respondent's attributes
tools.description: List all attributes of one respondent (names and string values), including those synced from integrations. Data Export API: GET /respondents/{respondent_uuid}/attributes.

items_per_page.description: Items per page (1-100). Omit for the API default.

next_url.description: pagination_data.next_url from the previous call. Pass it to get the next page; other paging inputs are then ignored.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Survicate
prompts.description: What you can do with Survicate here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: compare_response_counts_across_surveys
prompts.title: Compare response counts across surveys
prompts.description: List the surveys, newest first, with their type. Then list the responses of one survey in a time range.

prompts.name: read_the_answers_to_one_question
prompts.title: Read the answers to one question
prompts.description: List the questions of a survey to map question ids to their possible answers. Then list the responses filtered by a respondent attribute.

prompts.name: review_one_respondent_s_history
prompts.title: Review one respondent's history
prompts.description: Read every response one respondent gave, across all surveys. Then read the attributes of that respondent, including those synced from integrations.

prompts.name: open_one_response_in_full
prompts.title: Open one response in full
prompts.description: Get the survey to see the attribute names it sends. Then get one response with its answers, device and language.
